dialogues.jp:
この学園にこんなに人数が居たのかと、思わず
疑問に思ってしまうくらい、男子学生の黒い制
服で館内はいっぱいだ。
dialogues.en:
Did this school really have this many people? That's what I
asked myself as I gazed over the numerous male students.
dialogues.text:
Did this school really have this many people? That's what I
asked myself as I gazed over the numerous male students.

dialogues.jp: 「……暇な奴らめ」
dialogues.en: "...Bunch of good-for-nothings."
dialogues.text: "...Bunch of good-for-nothings."

dialogues.jp:
ワイワイガヤガヤとしたざわめきに、何だか頭
痛まで覚えてしまう。
dialogues.en:
All the giggling and gaggling around the room made my head
throb.
dialogues.text:
All the giggling and gaggling around the room made my head
throb.

dialogues.en: "Haah..."
dialogues.text: "Haah..."

dialogues.jp:
ため息をつきつつ、壇上を見遣る。そして、再
びため息。そこには、こんな垂れ幕があるのだ。
dialogues.en:
I sighed heavily, and looked towards the stage. A second
heavy sigh followed. On the curtains was a large banner:
dialogues.text:
I sighed heavily, and looked towards the stage. A second
heavy sigh followed. On the curtains was a large banner:

dialogues.jp: “第２回　ミス風見学園コンテスト”
dialogues.en: "2nd Miss Kazami Academy Contest".
dialogues.text: "2nd Miss Kazami Academy Contest".

dialogues.jp: 「……二番煎じ」
dialogues.en: "...Rerun."
dialogues.text: "...Rerun."

dialogues.jp:
クリスマスの時と全く同じだ。それでも、これ
だけ人が集まるんだから嫌になる。
dialogues.en:
It was just the same as last Christmas. And just like last
Christmas, I didn't want to be around such a huge gathering
of people.
dialogues.text:
It was just the same as last Christmas. And just like last
Christmas, I didn't want to be around such a huge gathering
of people.

dialogues.jp: （衣装と引き替えに、ミスコンに出場……か）
dialogues.en:
"(About the only thing to look forward to is the girls that
actually come out...)"
dialogues.text:
"(About the only thing to look forward to is the girls that
actually come out...)"

dialogues.jp:
あの時は“いいんじゃないかな”なんて言った
くせに、いざとなってみると、釈然としない気
持ちがわき上がってくる。
dialogues.en:
Where all the boys suddenly learn exactly where their brain
is located.
dialogues.text:
Where all the boys suddenly learn exactly where their brain
is located.

dialogues.en: "Haah..."
dialogues.text: "Haah..."

dialogues.jp: 「何なんだろうな、このもやもやは……」
dialogues.en: "There's something strange about this..."
dialogues.text: "There's something strange about this..."

dialogues.speaker: Announcer
dialogues.jp: 「あー、マイクマイク……おっけー」
dialogues.en: "Ahh, testing testing 1, 2, 3."
dialogues.text: "Ahh, testing testing 1, 2, 3."

dialogues.speaker: Announcer
dialogues.jp: 「お、始まったか」
dialogues.en: "Oh, it's starting."
dialogues.text: "Oh, it's starting."

dialogues.speaker: Announcer
dialogues.jp: 「えー、大変長らくお待たせしました」
dialogues.en: "Our deepest apologies for the long wait."
dialogues.text: "Our deepest apologies for the long wait."

dialogues.jp: 潮のように、館内のざわめきがすっと遠のく。
dialogues.en:
Swept away by the wave of noise, the apology was barely
heard by the masses.
dialogues.text:
Swept away by the wave of noise, the apology was barely
heard by the masses.

dialogues.speaker: Announcer
dialogues.jp:
「それではこれより、手芸部主催の、ミス風見
　学園コンテストを実施します！」
dialogues.en:
"But now, we are proud to present you the Miss Kazami
Academy Contest, sponsored by the handicrafts club!"
dialogues.text:
"But now, we are proud to present you the Miss Kazami
Academy Contest, sponsored by the handicrafts club!"

dialogues.jp: わーわー。引いた潮が返ってくる。
dialogues.en:
A series of shouts of approval could be heard from the
audience.
dialogues.text:
A series of shouts of approval could be heard from the
audience.

dialogues.jp: 「ぶーぶー」
dialogues.en: "Boo, boo."
dialogues.text: "Boo, boo."

dialogues.jp:
早速のブーイングに、周りの何人かが｛いぶか／訝｝しげな
顔で振り返った。
dialogues.en:
Despite the comparitively soft booing coming from me,
several faces immediately turned towards me suspiciously.
dialogues.text:
Despite the comparitively soft booing coming from me,
several faces immediately turned towards me suspiciously.

dialogues.speaker: Announcer
dialogues.jp:
「それではエントリーＮｏ１。手芸部推薦の本
　命！　風見学園付属３年１組――朝倉音夢さ
　んです！」
dialogues.en:
"Let's welcome entry number 1! The handicraft club's hot
pick! From Kazami Academy's Year 3 Class 1--Asakura Nemu!!"
dialogues.text:
"Let's welcome entry number 1! The handicraft club's hot
pick! From Kazami Academy's Year 3 Class 1--Asakura Nemu!!"

dialogues.speaker: Announcer
dialogues.en: "Eh?"
dialogues.text: "Eh?"

dialogues.speaker: Announcer
dialogues.jp:
「──のはずだったのですが、いや、残念！　
　彼女は今回は、参加しておりません」
dialogues.en:
"--Is what I want to say, but unfortunately no! Asakura Nemu
will not be participating this year."
dialogues.text:
"--Is what I want to say, but unfortunately no! Asakura Nemu
will not be participating this year."

dialogues.jp: ぶーぶー。激しいブーイング。
dialogues.en: Boo boo, vehement booing commenced.
dialogues.text: Boo boo, vehement booing commenced.

dialogues.speaker: Announcer
dialogues.jp:
「いや〜、個人的には自分も残念なんですが
　……」
dialogues.en: "Nooo~~ I'm very disappointed myself!"
dialogues.text: "Nooo~~ I'm very disappointed myself!"

dialogues.speaker: Announcer
dialogues.jp:
「何せ、勧誘に行った手芸部員が、ことごとく
　原因不明の体調不良に襲われるという、不測
　の事態が起こりまして……」
dialogues.en:
"An invitation was sent for her to parcipate by the
handicraft club, but she cited that av illness prevented her
participation."
dialogues.text:
"An invitation was sent for her to parcipate by the
handicraft club, but she cited that av illness prevented her
participation."

dialogues.jp: 音夢の奴、手料理でも振舞ったのか？
dialogues.en: That Nemu, did she try and eat her own cooking?
dialogues.text: That Nemu, did she try and eat her own cooking?

dialogues.speaker: Announcer
dialogues.jp:
「え〜、お静かに。あまり進行の妨げになりま
　すと、最後の人まで回らない可能性が出てき
　ますからね」
dialogues.en:
"Ehh~~, please settle down. Although you may be disappointed
now, I'm sure you'd enjoy what we have saved for last."
dialogues.text:
"Ehh~~, please settle down. Although you may be disappointed
now, I'm sure you'd enjoy what we have saved for last."

dialogues.speaker: Announcer
dialogues.jp:
「これはここだけの話ですが、最後の人はとっ
　ておきらしいですよ」
dialogues.en: "So please sit back and enjoy the rest of the show!"
dialogues.text: "So please sit back and enjoy the rest of the show!"

dialogues.jp:
打ち明け話のように、声をひそめる。再び静ま
り返る館内。何やら、パブロフの犬めいている。
dialogues.en:
From his pacification, the audience quickly quietened down.
They must be Pavlov's dogs or something.
dialogues.text:
From his pacification, the audience quickly quietened down.
They must be Pavlov's dogs or something.

dialogues.speaker: Announcer
dialogues.jp: 「ではでは、気を取り直して参りましょう」
dialogues.en: "Now then, get ready for the first contestant!"
dialogues.text: "Now then, get ready for the first contestant!"

dialogues.speaker: Announcer
dialogues.jp:
「エントリーＮｏ１。風見学園付属２年３組
　……」
dialogues.en: "Entry number 1, From Kazami Academy Year 2 Class 3..."
dialogues.text: "Entry number 1, From Kazami Academy Year 2 Class 3..."

dialogues.jp:
ぼんやりとしているうちに、出場者達はどんど
んさばけていった。
dialogues.en:
I absentmindedly stared as the stage as contestant after
contestant came and left.
dialogues.text:
I absentmindedly stared as the stage as contestant after
contestant came and left.

dialogues.jp:
彼女達の受け答えに館内が一喜一憂していたが、
俺にとっては対岸の出来事にしか思えなかった。
dialogues.en:
I was completely oblivious to their answers on the greatest
joys and sorrows or whatever the hell the announcer was
asking them.
dialogues.text:
I was completely oblivious to their answers on the greatest
joys and sorrows or whatever the hell the announcer was
asking them.

dialogues.jp: 「ことりの番……まだ？」
dialogues.en: "Still not... Kotori's turn?"
dialogues.text: "Still not... Kotori's turn?"

dialogues.jp:
呟きに、何人かの顔がこちらを向く。微妙に目
に、敵意を含んで。
dialogues.en:
As I murmured, more people turned to face me. I knew they
were trying to hold back some vicious words.
dialogues.text:
As I murmured, more people turned to face me. I knew they
were trying to hold back some vicious words.

dialogues.jp: （かったる……）
dialogues.en: "(Troublesome...)"
dialogues.text: "(Troublesome...)"

dialogues.speaker: Announcer
dialogues.jp:
「えー、皆さんにお楽しみいただいた、第２回
　ミス風見学園コンテストも、次の方でラスト
　です」
dialogues.en:
"And now we present to you the final contestant in the Miss
Kazami Academy Contest!"
dialogues.text:
"And now we present to you the final contestant in the Miss
Kazami Academy Contest!"

dialogues.speaker: Announcer
dialogues.jp: 「やっとか」
dialogues.en: "Finally."
dialogues.text: "Finally."

dialogues.jp:
ってことは、さっき言っていた“とっておき”っ
てのは、ことりの事だった訳だ。
dialogues.en:
Of course when the announcer referred to saving for last at
the beginning, this was what he was meant.
dialogues.text:
Of course when the announcer referred to saving for last at
the beginning, this was what he was meant.

dialogues.speaker: Announcer
dialogues.jp:
「それではエントリーＮｏ２０。手芸部推薦の
　本命！　風見学園付属３年３組――白河こと
　りさんです！」
dialogues.en:
"Presenting the handicraft club's hot pick! From Year 3
Class 3 of Kazami Academy, Shirakawa Kotori!!"
dialogues.text:
"Presenting the handicraft club's hot pick! From Year 3
Class 3 of Kazami Academy, Shirakawa Kotori!!"

dialogues.jp:
ひときわ大きな歓声に、館内が揺れた──よう
にさえ思った。
dialogues.en:
The tremendous shout of joy from the crowd was enough to
make the entire stage sway.
dialogues.text:
The tremendous shout of joy from the crowd was enough to
make the entire stage sway.

dialogues.jp: （ことり……）
dialogues.en: "(Kotori...)"
dialogues.text: "(Kotori...)"

dialogues.jp:
対岸でしかなかったコンテストが、ぐっと身近
に迫ってくる。
dialogues.en:
I tried to push my way closer to the stage, but to little
avail.
dialogues.text:
I tried to push my way closer to the stage, but to little
avail.

dialogues.speaker: Announcer
dialogues.jp:
「えー、白河さん。ラストとしての気分はいか
　がですか？」
dialogues.en:
"So, Shirakawa-san, how do you feel about being the last
contestant?"
dialogues.text:
"So, Shirakawa-san, how do you feel about being the last
contestant?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「そうですね。何だか、待ちくたびれちゃった
　感じがします」
dialogues.en: "Yes, I feel like I've been waiting a long time for this."
dialogues.text: "Yes, I feel like I've been waiting a long time for this."

dialogues.speaker: Announcer
dialogues.jp:
「おお、何やら余裕の発言ですね。それは、自
　信の表れですか？」
dialogues.en:
"Ohh, very composed words! You must be feeling very
confident!"
dialogues.text:
"Ohh, very composed words! You must be feeling very
confident!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「え？　ち、違いますよー。だって、今だって、
　ドキドキして胸が痛いくらいなんですから」
dialogues.en:
"Eh? N, no, not really~ Right now, my heart is beating so
fast it hurts!"
dialogues.text:
"Eh? N, no, not really~ Right now, my heart is beating so
fast it hurts!"

dialogues.jp:
きゅっと胸元を押さえる。その仕草に、館内全
体がため息をもらした。
dialogues.en:
She placed her hand on her chest, and caused the entire
audience to let out a dreamy sigh.
dialogues.text:
She placed her hand on her chest, and caused the entire
audience to let out a dreamy sigh.

dialogues.speaker: Announcer
dialogues.jp:
「では最初に、なにかコメントや披露しておき
　たい特技があればどうぞ」
dialogues.en:
"Now, you said prior to your arrival that you had a special
announcement to make, so please go right ahead!"
dialogues.text:
"Now, you said prior to your arrival that you had a special
announcement to make, so please go right ahead!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「あ、時間は大分遅いんですけど、友達と一緒
　に楽曲の演奏をするんです。良かったら、皆
　さん、聴きに来てくださいね」
dialogues.en:
"Ah, although it's short notice, my friends and I will be
performing a musical piece for the graduation party. Please
come and listen!"
dialogues.text:
"Ah, although it's short notice, my friends and I will be
performing a musical piece for the graduation party. Please
come and listen!"

dialogues.jp:
館内のあちこちで、パンフレットが開かれた。
｛ちり／塵｝も積もれば何とやらで、耳を｛ろう／聾｝するような音
だ。
dialogues.en:
All around the room, I could hear the sounds of pamphlets
being opened. It was so loud, even the deaf could hear it.
dialogues.text:
All around the room, I could hear the sounds of pamphlets
being opened. It was so loud, even the deaf could hear it.

dialogues.speaker: Announcer
dialogues.jp:
「はいはい……それではテンポよくいきましょ
　う！　みなさんから頂いた質問にうつります」
dialogues.en:
"Alright, very well advertised! Now let's get the tempo back
with a few questions!"
dialogues.text:
"Alright, very well advertised! Now let's get the tempo back
with a few questions!"

dialogues.speaker: Announcer
dialogues.jp:
「えー、白河さんはどこの部活にも入ってませ
　んが、ぜひ手芸部にきませんか？」
dialogues.en:
"What club activities do you participate in? The handicrafts
club, perhaps?"
dialogues.text:
"What club activities do you participate in? The handicrafts
club, perhaps?"

dialogues.jp: ……どっかで耳にした質問だな。
dialogues.en: ...That's a question I hadn't heard yet.
dialogues.text: ...That's a question I hadn't heard yet.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「あ、えっと、私は中央委員会に所属している
　ので、特定の部には、ちょっと……」
dialogues.en:
"Ah, ehm, I regularly attend student committee meetings,
it's a sort-of special club..."
dialogues.text:
"Ah, ehm, I regularly attend student committee meetings,
it's a sort-of special club..."

dialogues.speaker: Announcer
dialogues.jp:
「はいはい、面白くないのでとっとと次へ……
　３サイズを教えてください、っと」
dialogues.en:
"Understood, not very interesting so let's move on! Now the
next question... please tell us your 3 sizes!"
dialogues.text:
"Understood, not very interesting so let's move on! Now the
next question... please tell us your 3 sizes!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「まぁ、だいたい、ドラうえもんと同じくらい
　です」
dialogues.en: "Well, it's about the same as Doraemon, you could say."
dialogues.text: "Well, it's about the same as Doraemon, you could say."

dialogues.speaker: Announcer
dialogues.jp:
「おっと、やおらマニアックなところを突いて
　きましたねえ。ドラちゃんって、それぞれの
　サイズがみんな一緒なんですよね」
dialogues.en:
"Whoa, we have a maniac here! Of course for those who don't
know, Dora-chan has the same sizes as every one of you!"
dialogues.text:
"Whoa, we have a maniac here! Of course for those who don't
know, Dora-chan has the same sizes as every one of you!"

dialogues.speaker: Announcer
dialogues.jp:
「……と、こほん、失礼しました。つい脱線し
　てしまいましたね」
dialogues.en: "...Ahem, excuse me! I have strayed off track!"
dialogues.text: "...Ahem, excuse me! I have strayed off track!"

dialogues.speaker: Announcer
dialogues.jp:
「では皆さん。最後の質問にして、とっておき
　の質問です。えー、ごほん」
dialogues.en: "Then, everyone, time for the final question! Ehh, ahem!"
dialogues.text: "Then, everyone, time for the final question! Ehh, ahem!"

dialogues.speaker: Announcer
dialogues.jp: 「ずばり好きな人の名前は？」
dialogues.en: "Do you have anyone you like?"
dialogues.text: "Do you have anyone you like?"

dialogues.jp: シン――と体育館が静まりかえる。
dialogues.en: In a flash, the entire audience went quiet.
dialogues.text: In a flash, the entire audience went quiet.

dialogues.jp:
半ば予想していたのだろう。ことりは驚いた様
子も見せず、静かに｛たたず／佇｝んでいる。
dialogues.en:
I half-expected a stupid question like this. I looked at
Kotori, and she had a surprisingly calm look on her face.
dialogues.text:
I half-expected a stupid question like this. I looked at
Kotori, and she had a surprisingly calm look on her face.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……実は、その質問は待っていたんです」
dialogues.en: "...Actually, I've been waiting for this question."
dialogues.text: "...Actually, I've been waiting for this question."

dialogues.jp:
俺だけじゃない。館内もざわめいた。司会者も
意表を突かれたのか、戸惑いの表情だ。
dialogues.en:
It wasn't just me either. The entire room was awash with
noise. Even the judges and announcer had a confused
expression.
dialogues.text:
It wasn't just me either. The entire room was awash with
noise. Even the judges and announcer had a confused
expression.

dialogues.speaker: Announcer
dialogues.jp: 「あ〜……待っていた、と言いますと？」
dialogues.en: "Ahh... waiting for this, you say?"
dialogues.text: "Ahh... waiting for this, you say?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……実はですね……」
dialogues.en: "...The truth is..."
dialogues.text: "...The truth is..."

dialogues.jp:
言葉が途切れる。ざわめきが、ボリュームコン
トロールを絞るように小さくなっていく。
dialogues.en:
She stopped in the middle of her words. The noise eventually
settled down as the audience figured out why she had paused.
dialogues.text:
She stopped in the middle of her words. The noise eventually
settled down as the audience figured out why she had paused.

dialogues.jp:
今、ひとりの例外もなく、全ての視線がことり
に集中していた。
dialogues.en:
Now, absolutely everyone's gaze was fixated straight on
Kotori.
dialogues.text:
Now, absolutely everyone's gaze was fixated straight on
Kotori.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「今、この場で、その人に告白しちゃおうと思
　うんです」
dialogues.en: "I wish to confess to this person right here, right now."
dialogues.text: "I wish to confess to this person right here, right now."

dialogues.jp:
あまりの衝撃に、館内は水を打ったような静け
さだ。司会も含め、全員が絶句している。
dialogues.en:
The impact of that revelation stunned everyone into complete
silence. The announcer and judges were speechless.
dialogues.text:
The impact of that revelation stunned everyone into complete
silence. The announcer and judges were speechless.

dialogues.jp:
そんなさなか、俺はよろよろと足を踏み出して
いた。
dialogues.en: Unable to think of anything else, I started walking.
dialogues.text: Unable to think of anything else, I started walking.

dialogues.jp:
壇上へと近づいていく。自分が何をしたいのか
も分からないままに……。
dialogues.en:
Walking closer to the stage. Why I did, even I didn't
understand.
dialogues.text:
Walking closer to the stage. Why I did, even I didn't
understand.

dialogues.speaker: Anouncer
dialogues.jp:
「……失礼。一瞬、固まってしまいました。そ
　れでは、お｛たず／訊｝ねしましょう」
dialogues.en:
"...Excuse me. To confirm the situation, I shall repeat my
question."
dialogues.text:
"...Excuse me. To confirm the situation, I shall repeat my
question."

dialogues.speaker: Announcer
dialogues.jp: 「ずばり、白河ことりさんの意中の人とは？」
dialogues.en: "Who is the person Shirakwa Kotori has in mind?"
dialogues.text: "Who is the person Shirakwa Kotori has in mind?"

dialogues.jp: 黒い人だかりを｛か／掻｝き分けて……。
dialogues.en: The hundreds of black shirts started stirring.
dialogues.text: The hundreds of black shirts started stirring.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「それは……」
dialogues.en: "His name is..."
dialogues.text: "His name is..."

dialogues.jp:
広い館内に、俺の足音だけが、やけに大きく聞
こえてくる……。
dialogues.en:
In the massive room, the sound of my footsteps echoed
loudly.
dialogues.text:
In the massive room, the sound of my footsteps echoed
loudly.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉……君……です」
dialogues.en: "Asakura...kun."
dialogues.text: "Asakura...kun."

dialogues.jp: 足音が止まった。
dialogues.en: The sound of footsteps stopped.
dialogues.text: The sound of footsteps stopped.

dialogues.jp:
完全な静寂。周りの人間達が、書き割りのよう
にしか思えない。
dialogues.en:
Complete silence. I could hear and feel nothing from the
surrounding people.
dialogues.text:
Complete silence. I could hear and feel nothing from the
surrounding people.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「私は、朝倉君が好きなんです」
dialogues.en: "The person I like, is Asakura-kun."
dialogues.text: "The person I like, is Asakura-kun."

dialogues.jp:
一転して、ざわめき──怒号？　ともかく、す
さまじいまでの喧噪だった。
dialogues.en:
At once, the noise returned--angry ones? In any case, it was
quite scary.
dialogues.text:
At once, the noise returned--angry ones? In any case, it was
quite scary.

dialogues.jp:
ことりの学内における人気が、一気に反動となっ
て押し寄せてきたのだ。
dialogues.en:
I could feel the kickback from all the Kotori fanboys in the
room.
dialogues.text:
I could feel the kickback from all the Kotori fanboys in the
room.

dialogues.speaker: Announcer
dialogues.jp:
「はい、静粛に！　静かに！　静かにして下さ
　い！」
dialogues.en: "Excuse me! Please settle down! Please be quiet!"
dialogues.text: "Excuse me! Please settle down! Please be quiet!"

dialogues.jp:
……それが一体何度目の叫びなのか、司会の声
は既にかすれていた。
dialogues.en:
...Despite saying it several times, it was constantly
drowned out.
dialogues.text:
...Despite saying it several times, it was constantly
drowned out.

dialogues.jp:
その声に従ったというよりも、｛おの／自｝ずと精魂が尽
きてしまったように、再び静けさが舞い戻った。
dialogues.en:
But his persistence was to be admired. Eventually his cries
reached the audience, andmsilence returned to the room.
dialogues.text:
But his persistence was to be admired. Eventually his cries
reached the audience, andmsilence returned to the room.

dialogues.speaker: Announcer
dialogues.jp:
「えー、さっき、白河さんは、これを告白だと
　言いました。であるからには──」
dialogues.en:
"Ahem, so, Shirakawa-san has just said her confession.
However."
dialogues.text:
"Ahem, so, Shirakawa-san has just said her confession.
However."

dialogues.speaker: Announcer
dialogues.jp: 「それに、答えなければならないでしょう」
dialogues.en: "We do not have an answer as of yet!"
dialogues.text: "We do not have an answer as of yet!"

dialogues.speaker: Announcer
dialogues.jp:
「アサクラ君。居るのなら、壇上に上がって、
　白河さんに答えを」
dialogues.en:
"Asakura-kun. If you are here now, please come on stage and
give Shirakawa-san your answer!"
dialogues.text:
"Asakura-kun. If you are here now, please come on stage and
give Shirakawa-san your answer!"

dialogues.jp:
何度、音量の山と谷を繰り返したのか、再び、
にわかに騒がしくなる。
dialogues.en:
The recurrence of the noise that followed could be heard all
along the mountains and the valleys.
dialogues.text:
The recurrence of the noise that followed could be heard all
along the mountains and the valleys.

dialogues.jp:
誰彼となく顔を向け合っては、手と顔を横に振っ
ていた。いや、俺はアサクラじゃない……。
dialogues.en:
Everyone was staring at each other, wondering who this
Asakura was. But I'm not just Asakura...
dialogues.text:
Everyone was staring at each other, wondering who this
Asakura was. But I'm not just Asakura...

dialogues.jp: ──おれも。
dialogues.en: --I do too.
dialogues.text: --I do too.

dialogues.en: --I do too...
dialogues.text: --I do too...

dialogues.jp: 俺は──。

足を踏み出した。司会の言う通りだ。確かに、
応えてやらなければならない。
dialogues.en:
I continued walking. The announcer was right. I have to give
her a reply now.
dialogues.text:
I continued walking. The announcer was right. I have to give
her a reply now.

dialogues.jp:
これだけの人数の中、彼女は、ただ一人だけに
向けて、メッセージを発したのだから。
dialogues.en:
She stood in front of this many people in order to deliver
her message.
dialogues.text:
She stood in front of this many people in order to deliver
her message.

dialogues.jp: ……俺に向けて。
dialogues.en: ...Her message to me.
dialogues.text: ...Her message to me.

dialogues.jp: 壇上に立つ。
dialogues.en: I stepped up onto the stage.
dialogues.text: I stepped up onto the stage.

dialogues.jp:
スポットライトのただ中に、ことりが浮かび上
がっていた。こちらに、じっと目を向けて。
dialogues.en:
The spotlight was fixed squarely on Kotori, as she stared at
my darkened figure.
dialogues.text:
The spotlight was fixed squarely on Kotori, as she stared at
my darkened figure.

dialogues.jp:
膝に意思を込め、俺は前へと進む。ことりの居
るところまで進めなくて、恋愛もへったくれも
ない。
dialogues.en: I continued walking forward. Forward until I reached her.
dialogues.text: I continued walking forward. Forward until I reached her.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……ごめんね」
dialogues.en: "...I'm sorry."
dialogues.text: "...I'm sorry."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "Eh?"
dialogues.text: "Eh?"

dialogues.jp:
たぶん、司会にも聞こえないくらいの声で、そっ
と声を届けてくる。
dialogues.en:
She talked in a whisper that the announcer couldn't hear,
but I could.
dialogues.text:
She talked in a whisper that the announcer couldn't hear,
but I could.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「このくらいしないと、朝倉君に私の気持ちが
　届かないと思ったから……」
dialogues.en:
"If I didn't do it this way, I wasn't sure if my feelings
would reach you..."
dialogues.text:
"If I didn't do it this way, I wasn't sure if my feelings
would reach you..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉君、私、あなたの事が……」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-kun, I..."
dialogues.text: "Asakura-kun, I..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「好きです……」
dialogues.en: "I love you..."
dialogues.text: "I love you..."

dialogues.jp: ことりの気持ち。俺を好きだという気持ち。
dialogues.en: Kotori's feelings. Her feelings of love for me.
dialogues.text: Kotori's feelings. Her feelings of love for me.

dialogues.jp:
壇上で、みんなの視線にさらされてまで、俺に
届けたかった……。
dialogues.en:
Compared to that, the rest of the audience's stares couldn't
reach me on the stage...
dialogues.text:
Compared to that, the rest of the audience's stares couldn't
reach me on the stage...

dialogues.jp: 「うん……確かに、届いた」
dialogues.en: "Unn.. it definitely reached me."
dialogues.text: "Unn.. it definitely reached me."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ、今度は、俺の気持ちだな」
dialogues.en: "Now it's my turn to show my feelings."
dialogues.text: "Now it's my turn to show my feelings."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "...Okay."
dialogues.text: "...Okay."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「……俺は、言葉よりも、もっと雄弁な方法を
　採る事にする」
dialogues.en:
"...I'm not an eloquent speaker, so I have to show you in my
own way."
dialogues.text:
"...I'm not an eloquent speaker, so I have to show you in my
own way."

dialogues.jp:
ことりの気持ちに応えるには、それしかないと
思ったから。
dialogues.en: I replied to her in the way I felt I should.
dialogues.text: I replied to her in the way I felt I should.

dialogues.jp:
その瞬間は、ことり以外の何もかもが、意識の
外に追い払われていた。
dialogues.en: In that moment, my mind registered nothing except Kotori.
dialogues.text: In that moment, my mind registered nothing except Kotori.

dialogues.jp:
自分がどこに居て、周りに何があるのかさえも
忘れて、ただただ、唇の柔らかさだけを意識し
た。
dialogues.en:
Where I was, and my surroundings were forgotten. The only
thing I could sense were those soft, tender lips.
dialogues.text:
Where I was, and my surroundings were forgotten. The only
thing I could sense were those soft, tender lips.

dialogues.jp: そんな俺を……。
dialogues.en: And then I...
dialogues.text: And then I...

dialogues.jp:
地獄の釜が開いたような轟音が、現実へと強引
に引き戻した。
dialogues.en:
...quickly snapped back to reality, as a hellish roar cried
out from the crowd.
dialogues.text:
...quickly snapped back to reality, as a hellish roar cried
out from the crowd.

dialogues.jp: 「んげっ」

夢心地から一気に着地する。壇上の下は、まん
ま｛あびきょうかん／阿鼻叫喚｝の騒ぎだった。
dialogues.en:
While I was in dreamland, two of Buddhism's hells was taking
form in front of the stage.
dialogues.text:
While I was in dreamland, two of Buddhism's hells was taking
form in front of the stage.

dialogues.jp: 泣く奴、暴れる奴、何故か裸になっている奴…。
dialogues.en:
Crying ones, angry ones, even ones who were taking off their
clothes...
dialogues.text:
Crying ones, angry ones, even ones who were taking off their
clothes...

dialogues.speaker: Announcer
dialogues.jp: 「ここはひとまず、退散した方がいいですよ」
dialogues.en: "I think for now, it's best if you two leave for awhile."
dialogues.text: "I think for now, it's best if you two leave for awhile."

dialogues.speaker: Announcer
dialogues.jp: 「お、おう。そうだな」
dialogues.en: "O, okay, thanks."
dialogues.text: "O, okay, thanks."

dialogues.jp: 司会の的確な助言に感謝しつつ、俺は言った。
dialogues.en: I was saved by the announcer's quick-thinking suggestion.
dialogues.text: I was saved by the announcer's quick-thinking suggestion.

dialogues.jp: 「ことりっ。逃げるぞ！」
dialogues.en: "Kotori, let's go!"
dialogues.text: "Kotori, let's go!"

dialogues.jp: そんな場合じゃないとわかっていながら。
dialogues.en: She knows that this isn't the place as well.
dialogues.text: She knows that this isn't the place as well.

dialogues.jp: それでも顔を赤くして、俺は手を差し出して。
dialogues.en: With my face red, I held out my hand.
dialogues.text: With my face red, I held out my hand.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「うんっ！」
dialogues.en: "Okay!"
dialogues.text: "Okay!"

dialogues.jp:
やはり、顔を赤くしたことりが、その手を掴ん
だ。
dialogues.en: With a similarly red face, she held on to it.
dialogues.text: With a similarly red face, she held on to it.

dialogues.jp: ◆告白◆
dialogues.en: ◆On-Stage Confession◆
dialogues.text: ◆On-Stage Confession◆

dialogues.jp: ミス風見学園コンテストが始まった。
dialogues.en: The Miss Kazami Academy Contest started.
dialogues.text: The Miss Kazami Academy Contest started.

dialogues.jp:
少しして、ことりが壇上に上った。定型の質問
をする司会者。
dialogues.en:
After a bit, it was finally Kotori's turn. The announcer
asked her a fairly typical question.
dialogues.text:
After a bit, it was finally Kotori's turn. The announcer
asked her a fairly typical question.

dialogues.jp: 「好きな人の名前は？」
dialogues.en: "Is there anyone you like?"
dialogues.text: "Is there anyone you like?"

dialogues.jp:
それに対する答えが、俺の名前だった。俺は、
ふらふらと壇上へ向かった。
dialogues.en: Her answer was my name. I staggered my way onto the stage.
dialogues.text: Her answer was my name. I staggered my way onto the stage.

dialogues.jp: そして、俺達はキスを交わしたのだった……。
dialogues.en: And then, we kissed...
dialogues.text: And then, we kissed...
